methods.name: public void register()
methods.comment: * Registers the observer for all users.

methods.name: public void registerForCallingUser()
methods.comment: * Registers the observer for the calling user.

methods.name: public int getLeftSensitivity(Resources userRes)
methods.comment:
* Returns the left sensitivity for the current user.  To be used in code that runs primarily
     * in one user's process.

methods.name: public int getLeftSensitivityForCallingUser(Resources userRes)
methods.comment:
* Returns the left sensitivity for the calling user.  To be used in code that runs in a
     * per-user process.

methods.name: public int getRightSensitivity(Resources userRes)
methods.comment:
* Returns the right sensitivity for the current user.  To be used in code that runs primarily
     * in one user's process.

methods.name: public int getRightSensitivityForCallingUser(Resources userRes)
methods.comment:
* Returns the right sensitivity for the calling user.  To be used in code that runs in a
     * per-user process.
